text:
OH MY GOSH LOOK!!! IT’S LIKE A GIANT WATER BALLOON FIGHT BUT WITH BOTTLES!!! 

The boy in the RED HOODIE is leaning SO FAR OVER the balcony like a superhero saving the day (or trying to hit someone with a bottle! *giggles*) and he’s holding a GREEN BOTTLE that looks kinda squishy? Maybe it’s juice? Or maybe… SPLASHY STUFF?!

And look at the man below! He’s wearing white and he’s got his arm up like he’s gonna CATCH it or DUCK! His face is all scrunched up like when you try not to laugh too hard!

UP TOP THERE ARE EVEN MORE PEOPLE ON THE OTHER BALCONY! They’re watching like it’s the BEST SHOW EVER! One guy has a beard and one girl has her hand on her head like “OH NOOOO!” And another person is taking a PICTURE with their phone!! Everyone is excited!!

It’s like a giant game of tag but from different floors! I wanna join! Can we throw bottles? Wait no—can we throw WATER? YES PLEASE!! This is the COOLEST THING I’VE EVER SEEN!!! *jumps up and down*
